sloka: शूलैस्त्रिशूलैः कुलिशैः पट्टिशासिपरश्वधैः ।अन्योन्यं बिभिदुः क्रुद्धा राक्षसा दानवास्तथा ।। ७.२३.८ ॥
transliteration: śūlaistriśūlaiḥ kuliśaiḥ paṭṭiśāsiparaśvadhaiḥ ।anyonyaṁ bibhiduḥ kruddhā rākṣasā dānavāstathā ।। 7.23.8 ॥

translations.english: The enraged Rakshasas and Danavas fiercely pierced each other with spears, tridents, thunderbolts, sharp-edged spears, swords, and axes.
